summary: Contributors are expected to embrace AI tools, with mandatory human oversight: all AI-generated content must be reviewed, the contributor remains the sole responsible author, and substantial AI content must be labelled, for example with Assisted-by. evidence.quote: We expect our contributors to embrace AI tools.
All AI-generated content must be thoroughly reviewed by the contributor before being submitted for review.
Transparently label all contributions containing substantial AI-generated content.
The contributor remains the sole author and is fully responsible for the contribution’s accuracy, quality, and maintainability.
Comments and feedback on pull requests or issues
